Class King

java.lang.Object
pieces.Piece
pieces.King
public class King extends Piece
Represents a King chess piece ("wK" for White, "bK" for Black). The King moves one square in any direction (horizontally, vertically, or diagonally) and may also perform castling if neither the King nor the corresponding Rook has moved.

    • canCastleWithRook

      private boolean canCastleWithRook(Board board, Position rookPos, int[] emptyCols)
      Helper method to verify whether the King can castle with the Rook at the specified corner, ensuring the Rook has not moved and all squares between them are empty.
      Parameters:
      board - the current chessboard state
      rookPos - the expected starting coordinate of the friendly Rook
      emptyCols - the column indices between the King and Rook that must be unoccupied
      Returns:
      true if the Rook is unmoved and the intervening path is clear; false otherwise
